what_this_is: Gate A for PFRocketLanding on cuda, RE-MEASURED in Step 8 on the SAME corpus (sha256 f4707e54f3007b2e9afb1c236e932626373ee767eaa705161d53faa937d6eedf, 64 states) and the SAME protocol as the Step-7 closure2 shard, through the same driver (scratch/step7/closure/gate_a_new_cells.py, examples/fidelity_step4.measure). It exists for one reason: the closure2 shard's provenance recorded eleven packages and PyFlyt/pybullet were not among them, so check_visual_fidelity and check_visual_fidelity_under_variation could only be judged blocked_environment on 'version not recorded by the measuring interpreter'. This run records them, at exactly the versions the class declares. The closure2 shard is kept unchanged as the history of what was measured when.
